Diagnosis.submission: The user-service Kubernetes service has no endpoints because its service selector includes an extra label "current_service_name=user-service" that does not exist on the user-service pod labels. All other services use the standard selector {"service":"<name>"} which matches their pod labels. The user-service service selector should be {"service":"user-service"} to match the pod labels. Because the user-service has no endpoints, any service that depends on it (notably compose-post-service) gets connection refused when trying to reach user-service:9090, which cascades into the nginx-thrift gateway failing to process compose-post requests.
